answer: A Code contribution passing automated tests backed by a sponsor's vouch turns each identity into a small portfolio: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the sponsor's vouch is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so the account with a real record of accepted work is trusted and the empty one is not. A atlas out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its work clears. When the ivory settles over the vertex, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
